item.title: Looking for theme suggestions *dark*!
item.description:
https://preview.redd.it/ban7iux8asxe1.png?width=880&format=png&auto=webp&s=6f9e324a4c69d816e9fc7de94e132ddbf5ac75e4
I am currently using a theme off of github called [SynthwaveBlack](https://github.com/roshandarji/synthwaveBLACK). However, my frame remains that slightly aggravating blue color. I'd love a theme that feels like this but has a truly black feel. Any suggestions? :-)
Edit to add I have enjoying using a theme with highlight or glow text as it helps me visually. [Epergoes (Light)](https://github.com/DesiQuintans/epergoes) was a big one for me for a long time but I feel like I work at night more now and need a dark theme.
